children: to transfer its primary stock exchange listings from the New York Stock Exchange to the Texas Stock Exchange.

Phil Green, chairman and CEO of Cullen/Frost said the company believes Texas is experiencing a significant period of economic growth, with more businesses and people in the financial sector moving to the state, particularly toward the emerging "Y'all Street" financial district in Dallas.
He added that the listing transfer would reinforce Cullen/Frost's position as a leading Texas-based financial institution.

The move covers the company's common stock, which trades under the ticker CFR, and its depositary shares representing a 1/40th interest in its 4.450% non-cumulative perpetual preferred stock, Series B, which trade under the ticker CFR.PrB.

title: Cullen/Frost Bankers to move listing to Texas Stock Exchange
